page.overview:
Who is Diane?

Diane is a baby female Triceratops that could be encountered at The Lost World area at Universal Studios Singapore.

Diane could be met at Universal Studios Singapore in The Lost World. She is held by a dinosaur handler while guests can take photos with the baby.
